title: Part B deployment test of g v2 with a channel-current replica, one BSIM4 model-check state (b4check.c clamp written into every card) and the element-identity Q2 reference; M_bias v1 full-data g as reference arm; sky130 77 K, 18 devices
done_before: code draft and unit tests (not committed)
binary check: card-only library deck on the OSDI build = simulate_pdk state C on 3 starting cards (difference 0.0)
one OpenVAF compile of a v1 fold module (0.9 s)

fix1_clamp.rule: b4check.c A1/A2 clamp written into the card (a2 > 1 -> a2 = 1, a1 = 0; a2 < 0.01 -> 0.01) by every deck builder with more than one analysis per process
builders: spice_batch.simulate_pdk_multi (altermod, parallel, separate; bsim4_state default clamped)
fix1_clamp.legacy_kept: bsim4_state='legacy' reproduces the old decks; i12_1_diagnosis.py uses legacy
fix1_clamp.unit_tests: a2 = 1.9 card on nmos_L0p19_W7: simulate_pdk_multi altermod and separate = simulate_pdk state C (difference 0); parallel within 1e-6 relative; simulate_truth and simulate_sky130 = simulate_pdk state C (difference 0); patched_library writes a2 = 1

fix2_replica.gmin_compensation: VCCS -M_DEV*gmin between replica drain and body copies, gmin = 1e-12 S (ngspice default, no deck sets gmin), M_DEV = 1 (BSIM4 instance m inside the subcircuit, printed in every pre-check run)

precheck.grid: I11-1 grid 75 x 149, tight, 17 digits, canonical ngspice-41

fix2_replica.precheck_result: requested criterion (replica drain current = card channel current within 1e-12 relative) met only in part: P1 exact; P2 to solver tolerance (max 1.7e-12 A); P3 within 1e-12 on every forward point for 2-6 of 18 devices, up to 1.2e-3 forward (card Isub through the rbodymod = 1 body network) and up to 218 in the reverse quadrant (forward-biased drain junction)
fix2_replica.consequence: the element scales the replica channel current I_rep; every Part B reference uses I_rep measured in a card + replica run of the same deck, tolerance and clamp state

fix3_q2_reference: Re Y_elem = Re Y_card + (exp(g) - 1) Re Y_rep + I_rep exp(g) dg/dV; Im Y_elem = Im Y_card; Y_card, Y_rep, I_rep, I_card from one card + replica run; capacitance check unchanged

part_B.cards: M2: refit from direct43_r3_fd with the arm's full-data g frozen in the loop (TRF, max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01, state C)
core: Q3 0 circuits failing only with the element
restrictions: >= 1 gds curve (of 90) with an introduced sign change
part_B.label: any core fail -> not deployable; core pass and >= 1 restriction -> deployable with restrictions; else deployable (simulator-level)
part_B.amendment_A1_of_I12_1: applies (circuit runtime ratio over circuits where M2_card and M2_full pass; no repeats after a failed run)
part_B.reference_arm_v1: same stages with full|M_bias (inputs is_pmos, |V(g,s)|/VDD, |V(d,s)|/VDD; module i14_1_bias_corr_v1); label reported, not the outcome; exchanged-terminal Verilog-A check expected to fail

accuracy.element_deck: reported, no rule: native RRMS of the held-out pairs (v2 and v1), Python and channel-model Python RRMS, differences to the I13-1 rows, all-device / combined / median, GMR(native v2, C0_refit), GMR(native v2, stored v1), GMR(native v2, native v1), GMR(native v1, C0_refit)

validity.V1: card-only library deck (OSDI build, clamp written) x exp(fold g) reproduces the 36 I13-1 rows (v2, v1): max |diff| <= 1e-9
validity.V2: unit tests tests.test_i14_1_chan, test_i13_1_clamp, test_spice_batch, test_sky130_misspec, test_i12_1_symm pass
validity.V3: 18 element-deck accuracy rows per arm; 0 failed M2 refits per arm

decision.invalid: any validity fail -> stop: fix and re-register
decision.not deployable: Part B (v2) not deployable -> stop; diagnose the failed core checks
decision.deployable, accuracy below v1 (not non-i: Part B (v2) deployable with restrictions or deployable (simulator-level) -> stop v2; report the accuracy cost of the deployment constraints
decision.note: A1 pass / A2 fail fixed by I13-1; element-deck accuracy and the reference arm do not change the outcome

order: queue: I14_1_validity, I14_1_accuracy, I14_1_deploy_v2, I14_1_deploy_v1, I14_1_decide
